name: skill-list
title: SkillList
description: The skills of an A2A Agent Card: id, name, calls, tags and last test result per skill, with a fallback entry for messages no skill matched.

a11y.pattern: <ul aria-label> of <li> holding a <button aria-pressed> (selectable) or a <div> (read-only)
keyboard: Moves between the skills of a selectable list
Selects the skill; the detail updates in its own region
aria: The list is named ("Skills of Pastry concierge 1.0"); a selected skill uses aria-pressed, not role=tab
The call count is read with its unit ("14 calls in 24 hours")
The test result is an icon plus the word passed or failed, and an optional sentence read after it
The fallback entry is dashed and written "No skill matched"; a dashed outline is never the only signal
a11y.notes: Announce the detail change politely when the selection moves it out of view. Keep ids as plain text so they can be selected and copied.
